revised_operational_plans.tactical_thesis: Test a seven-ID role-fusion structure: Cardigan permanently combines lower-outer containment, artillery absorption and self-recovery, replacing both Melantha and Spot. Preserve two physicians and Steward's artillery-to-central rotation. Transfer eastern lower-roadblock clearance to Steward after combat. This removes the failed permanent-Melantha survival dependency and avoids replacement into a locked shell, but does not establish a WIN: protected-target exposure, shared medical load and upper-central armor clearance remain decisive unverified conditions.
